name: Detection failure

subjectOf.text: Natural language processing driven compliance assumes static legal frameworks, so novel transaction types generated by evolving AI agents outstrip predefined rules and go undetected by centralized systems that lack external validation.
subjectOf.abstract: NLP-driven compliance assumes static legal frameworks, yet AI agents' evolution introduces novel transaction types that outstrip predefined rules, undetected by centralized systems lacking external validation.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How can we Best Monitor AI Agents (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5245185
scope_conditions: NLP based rule application to transaction data
novel transaction types produced by agent evolution

subjectOf.text: Economic institutions that rely on lagging indicators such as price signals, employment data, and GDP reports cannot detect AI driven transformation, because the transformation propagates faster than the monitoring systems built to observe it.
subjectOf.abstract: Institutions in linear systems that depend on advance warning—price signals, employment data, and GDP reports—cannot detect a transformation that propagates faster than the information systems designed to monitor it.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Collapse of Scarcity Economics (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6421319
scope_conditions: applies to institutions whose detection depends on advance warning indicators
